meta.title: Markji Bridge
meta.description: Four action-based agent tools for Markji decks, chapters, cards, sync, conflicts and files: a single-file SQLite cache, plain-text and JSON condition-tree filtering (all/deck/chapter) that ignores formatting, media and base64, queued batch edits, chapter detail/create/rename/sort, card archive, failure/conflict recovery, multi-process write locking, background sync tasks with live progress, waiting and crash-resume, file upload, a plugin page for an encrypted API Key and cache.db directory, automatic syntax/media preflight on create/update, and bulk conflict resolution.
